input.plans: [{"ruleId":"LOL-CAP","candidateSectionIds":["sec-p0115"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0240","p0126","p0127","p0241","p0276"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"No monetary cap; liability regime is built from (i) p0240 (21.x: liability limited to express provisions, several and not joint), (ii) p0126/p0127 (PG members not liable; no representations/warranties re Supply Contract, Wet Segment performance, integration), and (iii) p0241 (mutual cross-indemnity). Worker should assess mutuality, absence of aggregate cap and absence of consequential-damages exclusion in a consortium C&MA context; note several-not-joint liability benefits us."},{"ruleId":"INDEMN","candidateSectionIds":["sec-p0115","sec-32"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0241","p0275","p0276","p0280","p0034"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"Not missing: p0241 (21.2) is a reciprocal each-Party indemnity for claims arising from ownership of APCN 2; Paragraph 32 (p0275-p0280) governs settlement/sharing of third-party claims, notice, no admission of liability without Management Committee approval, and survival on termination. No IP-infringement indemnity was located — worker should confirm across Paragraph 32 pagination and note whether the multilateral structure (rather than vendor-to-customer) satisfies the fallback."},{"ruleId":"NONCOMPETE","candidateSectionIds":["sec-p0115"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0206","p0208"],"likelyAbsent":true,"note":"No non-compete or field-of-use restriction found; 'compete' hits are only 'competent jurisdiction/tribunal'. p0206/p0208 in fact confirm Parties may sell IRU/use Allocated Capacity 'without any restrictions' — freedom-preserving and not to be flagged."},{"ruleId":"EXCLUSIVITY","candidateSectionIds":["sec-p0115"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0262"],"likelyAbsent":true,"note":"No supply exclusivity or sole-source obligation located. The only 'exclusive' hit (p0262) is the sole-and-exclusive dispute remedy in Paragraph 27, which belongs to GOVLAW rather than this rule; confirm and mark not applicable."},{"ruleId":"MFN","candidateSectionIds":["sec-p0115"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0220","p0225"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"Direction check: p0220 (Paragraph 15/16 transiting or inland facilities) requires facilities on terms 'no less favorable than those granted to another Carrier', and p0225 requires arrangements to be 'reasonable and non-discriminatory'. These run mutually among Parties and largely favour us as a capacity acquirer; worker should verify we are not the obligor giving best terms without reciprocity before treating as burdening."},{"ruleId":"NOSOLICIT","candidateSectionIds":[],"candidateParagraphIds":[],"likelyAbsent":true,"note":"No hits for solicit, employ, personnel or recruit anywhere in the document. Assess whether the no-exit-during-25-year-Initial-Period plus forfeiture of capital-cost credit breaches the fallback."},{"ruleId":"RENEWAL","candidateSectionIds":["sec-p0115"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0228","p0229","p0230","p0231"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"No auto-renewal mechanic; instead a 25-year Initial Period that continues until decommissioned/terminated (p0228, p0230 two-thirds decommissioning vote). Worker should treat continuation-in-force as the analogue and assess exit ease and notice window; no renewal pricing uplift to cap."},{"ruleId":"GOVLAW","candidateSectionIds":["sec-27","sec-25","sec-p0115"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0029","p0262","p0027","p0260","p0239"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"No express governing-law clause located (searches for 'laws of the State', 'construed in accordance' returned nothing). Dispute resolution is p0262 (Paragraph 27: refer to Management Committee, which may determine arbitration; sole and exclusive remedy), with p0239 (Paragraph 20 privilege on arbitration documents) and p0260 (Paragraph 25 general compliance with applicable laws). No data-return or transition-assistance obligation located — worker to confirm across Paragraph 18/32 pagination before calling it missing."}]}
